description: Ratio: turns a whole-number ratio into the volt per octave offset for that interval, added to a root pitch, for tuning linear FM and phase modulation to harmonious intervals

params.text: Sets the numerator of the ratio, a whole number from 1 to 128; at 1 with the denominator climbing you get the subharmonic series
Attenuates and inverts the NUM CV input, which counts 1 per 0.1V at 100%
Rounds the numerator CV to whole multiples of 1 to 8, so a sweep steps through octaves, fifths or wider intervals rather than every number
Sets the denominator of the ratio, a whole number from 1 to 128; at 1 with the numerator climbing you get the harmonic series
Attenuates and inverts the DEN CV input, which counts 1 per 0.1V at 100%
Rounds the denominator CV to whole multiples of 1 to 8, so a sweep steps through octaves, fifths or wider intervals rather than every number

inputs.text: Moves the numerator, added to the NUM knob through the attenuverter below it; the total is held between 1 and 199
Moves the denominator, added to the DEN knob through the attenuverter below it; the total is held between 1 and 199
The pitch the ratio is measured from, added to the interval to give the output; normalled to 0V

outputs.text: The root pitch plus the base two logarithm of the numerator over the denominator, in volts per octave

notes: the two numeric displays show the numerator and the denominator in force once their CV has been added; neither can be clicked for help
every input takes polyphony, and the output carries as many channels as the widest input; a monophonic input is copied to every channel
bypassing this module passes the ROOT input straight to the output

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
